name: Property manager
summary: Looks after rental property for small landlords: tenant notices, maintenance logs, owner reports and the numbers on new deals.

changelog.note: First release: 27 sources (GOV.UK Renters' Rights Act, deposit, safety and database pages; DOJ and statute text on fair housing; FTC, EPA, IRS), four skills (notices, maintenance, screening and tenancy files, owner reports and deal numbers), six prompts, three workflows, training files and access levels per tool.
